sections.text: مقدمة

The foam system provided as protection of the three fuel storage tanks. The 
system operates automatically on signal given by the two heat sensitive cables 
at each or can be initiated manually
Fuel tank data
The foam system consists of
- خزان تخزين مركزات الرغوة بسعة 11 متر مكعب

Balanced pressure proportioning unit complete with two foam pumps, one acting as 
stand - by to the other
Proportioning unit supply the foam chambers of the foam solution
Four foam chambers fitted at the top of each of the fuel oil tank
عمل شبكة توزيع محلول الرغوة
Heat sensitive cable rings on each fuel oil tank
Electronic monitoring control
Control panels

Solenoid actuated valves, one for each fuel oil tank connected to the 
pressurized ring

sections.text: فحص وصيانة

The concentrate foam solution must be checked for its expansion from time to 
 time (monthly)
Flush water supply pipes and foam pipesto remove scale (monthly)
Check efficiency of deluge valves (monthly)
Simulate "fault" or "alarm" conditions to test the foam fire system (monthly)
Check pumps grease (monthly)
Check pumps seals and tighten (yearly)
Check the operation of the foam pumps and recirculate the foam to the tank
